title: 2026 U.S. House of Representatives election in California's 33rd Congressional District
description: The general election for California's 33rd Congressional District pits incumbent Democratic Rep. Pete Aguilar against Republican challenger Stephanie M. Vargas. Aguilar, who has represented the district (previously the 31st) since 2015, serves as House Democratic Caucus Chair, the No. 3 position in House Democratic leadership. Vargas is the Chief Deputy City Clerk for the City of Colton and a lifelong Inland Empire resident. The June 2, 2026 top-two primary advanced Aguilar (53.5%) and Vargas (17.5%) to the general election. The district, covering San Bernardino, Rialto, Colton, and parts of Redlands, has a Cook Partisan Voting Index of D+7 and is rated 'Solid D' by the Cook Political Report, reflecting a strong Democratic lean, though cost-of-living and public-safety concerns are key issues in the campaign.
polling_note: No independent public opinion polls were found for this race as of the primary election results. The Cook Political Report rates the seat as 'Solid D' based on district fundamentals.

candidates.name: Pete Aguilar
candidates.summary: Pete Aguilar is the incumbent U.S. Representative for California's 33rd Congressional District, first elected in 2014. He serves as Chair of the House Democratic Caucus, making him the highest-ranking Latino in Congress and the No. 3 House Democrat. Before Congress, he was Mayor of Redlands and a Redlands City Councilmember, and he worked as Deputy Director of the Inland Empire Regional Office under Governor Gray Davis.

candidates.name: Stephanie M. Vargas
candidates.summary: Stephanie M. Vargas is a Republican candidate running for U.S. House in California's 33rd Congressional District. She serves as Chief Deputy City Clerk and Elections Official for the City of Colton, and has held leadership roles on charter school boards and policy committees. Her campaign focuses on lowering the cost of living, election integrity, public safety, and parental rights.

forecast.rationale: No independent general-election polls exist for this race. The forecast is based on district fundamentals and primary results. California's 33rd District has a Cook PVI of D+7 and is rated 'Solid D' by Cook Political Report. Incumbent Pete Aguilar is a well-established 11-year representative and House Democratic Caucus Chair (the No. 3 House Democrat). In the June 2, 2026 top-two primary, Aguilar received 53.5% of the vote versus Republican challenger Stephanie M. Vargas's 17.5%, with the remainder of the vote spread across other candidates in a field that heavily favors Democrats given the district's partisan lean. The strong incumbency advantage, favorable district fundamentals, and lopsided primary result all point to a very strong Democratic advantage. However, the absence of any general-election polling limits confidence below high.
